projects.kubescluster.overview.1: Modern enterprise seems to be built upon the Kubernetes leviathan. As a consequence, it would be remiss to omit it from my set of reference clusters.
projects.kubescluster.overview.2: Metadata descriptions for twenty worker nodes and a control-plane node were defined in COVERT. Given that Kubernetes has a dependency on systemd,
and prior build experience was founded in virtuaised Arch linux, this distribution was chosen to host my Kubernetes reference architecture.
projects.kubescluster.overview.3: Given that Kubernetes is not only dependent upon systemd, but 'has other hairs on it', the cluster name, 'Mons_Pubis' was chosen to reflect nature of kubes
and the obvious rhyming denigration.:-D That said, pragmatism must win at the end of the day. Here, then, is my venture into the distasteful realm of kubernetes.
